move: fruit drops with CustomBounce squash, wordmark letters flinch on impact
how: A dark green stage with a thin floor line, a serif wordmark split into letters resting on it, four SVG fruits above and a masked subline. The floor draws scaleX 0 to 1 (expo.out). Each fruit falls from y -220 to the floor over 1.3s with a CustomBounce ease (strength 0.6) while a paired squash tween drives scaleX 1.35 scaleY 0.65 from the bottom origin, starting 0.18s apart from 2.5%. Letters rise yPercent 120 to 0 (expo.out, 0.05 stagger) then at 21% flinch yPercent -10 scaleY 0.92 from the edges and settle with elastic.out(1,0.4). The fruit rolls +/-8deg (sine.inOut yoyo) during the hold; at 82% fruit launches up with back.in(2), letters drop yPercent 120, the subline flies up and the floor retracts.
adapt: Change the wordmark, the fruit SVGs (any count, 0.18s apart) and colours; keep the CustomBounce strength 0.6 with squash 3 and the 1.3s drop.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the letters and fruit; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with drops at (0.025 + i*0.045)D and the exit at 0.82D. landY depends on the 720 stage height and must be derived from el; CustomBounce.create should run once in mount.
caveats: the wordmark has no overflow mask so at yPercent 120 the lower part of the letters stays visible below the baseline on the first and last frames
landY is hard-coded for a 720px stage
